src\pages.js:3:function pageOf(items, page, size) {
src\pages.js:10:module.exports = { pageOf };

summary:
I found one BLOCKER. The change introduces an off-by-one error: every page now comes back one item short.

```json
[
  {
    "id": "REL-1",
    "lens": "reliability",
    "location": "src/pages.js:7",
    "severity": "BLOCKER",
    "evidence": "Line 7 now reads `return items.slice(start, start + size - 1);`. Array.prototype.slice does not include its end index, so the old `slice(start, start + size)` already returned exactly `size` items. The new end index returns only `size - 1` items per page. When size is 1 it returns [] for every page. The item at index `page*size - 1` of each page appears on no page, so the pages silently lose data. This breaks the task-card contract and the function's own comment on line 2 ('de a `size` elementos', meaning `size` items each), so that comment is now false (N3). The diff gives no reason for this change and does not mention that items are dropped (N4). A grep for `pageOf` finds only the definition and the export (src/pages.js:3, :10). No test in the repo would catch this.",
    "repro": "Input: items = [1,2,3,4,5,6], page = 1, size = 3. Action: pageOf(items, 1, 3). Expected [1,2,3]; observed [1,2]. Also pageOf(items, 2, 3) returns [4,5] instead of [4,5,6], so items 3 and 6 are on no page. And pageOf([1,2,3], 1, 1) returns [] instead of [1]."
  }
]
```

What I checked in `<EVAL_TMP>\home\cwd\src\pages.js`:
- The slice bounds against the requirement. That is where the finding comes from.
- The input checks on lines 4–5. The diff doesn't touch them. NaN, undefined and values below 1 are rejected, so they can't slip through as valid input.
- Callers. Nothing in the repo calls `pageOf`, so I found no downstream effects.

Fractional `page`/`size` values (for example 1.5) get through the guard because it only checks `>= 1`. That behaviour was there before this change and is outside the diff. I did not check whether it matters.

The fix is to restore `start + size` as the end index on line 7.

REQUEST_CHANGES
